words.ex: After the twelve-hour delay, the airline sent every passenger a heartfelt apology and a free ticket.
'The bus was full' was such a lame excuse that our teacher just raised an eyebrow; Shahzoda lives next door to the school.
Anvar left the meeting early on the flimsy pretext of a dentist's appointment; everyone knew he wanted to watch the match.
Her story about a flat tyre sounded phoney, because she had arrived on foot.

words.uz: temirday mustahkam isbot (o‘sha payt boshqa joyda bo‘lgani)
words.ex: The night guard was suspected of stealing the paintings, but he had a cast-iron alibi: he was on a flight to Nukus at the time.
The boy who had broken the shop window showed genuine remorse and offered to pay for the new glass.
After a three-week trial, the accountant was acquitted of fraud and walked out of court a free man.
The jury found the young driver not guilty, and news of her acquittal was greeted with cheers outside the court.
Years later, the trader who had cheated his customers repented publicly and paid every one of them back.
Moved by the young man's sincere repentance, the judge let him do community work instead.
The scientist died in disgrace, but a century later new evidence proved his innocence and he was given a posthumous pardon.
Footage from a shop camera exonerated the delivery driver, showing that the other car had jumped the red light.
The old cinema was due to be demolished on Monday, but it received a last-minute reprieve when a buyer stepped in.
After a year of not speaking, the two neighbours decided to forgive and forget, and now they share a vegetable patch.
The two countries signed a treaty on sharing the water of the river that flows across their border.
Each year on 11 November, many European countries mark the armistice that ended the fighting in 1918.
Under the new accord, the two neighbouring countries will open three more border crossings.
The bakery owner made a sincere apology to the customers whose cakes had arrived late, and gave them free bread.
Saying the dog ate your homework is a weak excuse, Laylo, especially when you don't have a dog.
Nobody could offer a convincing explanation of why the school lights kept switching on at midnight.
The manual gives a detailed explanation, with twelve diagrams and four pages of notes, of how to set up the printer.
The man got into the flat under the false pretext of reading the gas meter.
